summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing resignations and appointments of directors on May 12-13, 2026. Directors Sheng Gong and Jianhua Cheng resigned for personal reasons with no disagreement. Lei Cai and Jian Zhang were appointed to fill vacancies, with Zhang also joining committees. No financial terms, consideration, or premium were involved. The filing is a standard governance update for a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer. Watch for any further board changes or follow-on events, though no risk-arb angle exists.
